narration: For {identical_months} months nothing told the two lives apart. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. The first thing to part was {first_bar_apart}, in month {first_bar_apart_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost's money against yours was {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month}, the ghost's money was {net_worth_gap}. Its days held a little more living than yours, Life {life_gap}.
